messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

We recognise the genuine copper pressure behind your quote and the constraints of your published-price policy. Thank you for setting out the cost drivers so clearly.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

Our analysis supports a package linking payment flexibility with fixed-price certainty, giving both teams a clear planning basis and you a concrete proposal for internal review. We are flexible on payment terms; which option works best within your approval process?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 362.25 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 358.15 per unit, payment 30 days net, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 359.22 per unit, payment 45 days net, fixed price, no index clause.

We value our longstanding relationship and look forward to finding workable terms together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

Our current Angebot is a price of €373.13 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

In response to your inquiry regarding payment terms, 30 days net remains our standard and preferred option. Based on this volume adjustment and the 30-day payment term, we propose a revised price of €369.02 per unit. This alternative package of a price of €369.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel is at our standard terms.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Credit Control: We refer to our standard Zahlungsziel, which is 30 days net.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

The term sheets set out the annual volume we can commit to. Thank you for validating our forecast and improving your offer; we recognise that standard payment terms are your preferred basis.

Your latest offer is still 7.1% above today's price of EUR 348.32.

Our revised package makes a modest price concession while retaining extended payment and fixed pricing, with committed volume supporting your capacity planning. We ask for a reciprocal step toward the proposed package to close the remaining gap. We can commit to 6,110 units per year, as set out in the term sheets.

We propose: EUR 368.74 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, no index clause.

We are close to agreement, and we appreciate your efforts to carry our longstanding partnership forward.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
